verses.text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

segments.text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah;
And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.text: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. [Selah

segments.text: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire,
And hast not withholden the request of his lips. [Selah

verses.text: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.

segments.text: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness:
Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.

verses.text: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.

segments.text: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him,
Even length of days for ever and ever.

verses.text: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.

segments.text: His glory is great in thy salvation:
Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.

verses.text: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.

segments.text: For thou makest him most blessed for ever:
Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.

verses.text: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

segments.text: For the king trusteth in Jehovah;
And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

verses.text: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.

segments.text: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies;
Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.

verses.text: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.

segments.text: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger:
Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath,
And the fire shall devour them.

verses.text: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.

segments.text: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth,
And their seed from among the children of men.

verses.text: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.

segments.text: For they intended evil against thee;
They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.

verses.text: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.

segments.text: For thou wilt make them turn their back;
Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.

verses.text: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.

segments.text: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength:
So will we sing and praise thy power.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
